confidence_notes: I ran three web searches. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from Numbeo's crowd-sourced figures for Byron Bay, last updated October 2025: inexpensive meal about A$25, mid-range meal for two about A$120 (another Numbeo comparison page shows A$105), domestic draft pint A$11.50 and cappuccino A$5.33. I raised these slightly for prices in July 2026. The Numbeo sample for Byron Bay is small, so these figures are uncertain. Cocktail and wine anchors come from a few 2024-2025 Byron Bay venue menus and listings: regular-menu cocktails about A$22-25, happy-hour cocktails A$14-16 and a 120ml prosecco pour at A$16. These are single venues rather than averages, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are my own estimates from general knowledge, with no search or live listings. Byron Bay is a costly resort town where rooms in July cost less than in summer but more during school holidays. Treat accommodation as the least certain group. FX: the search tool's summary reported an RBA 4pm figure of 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026, citing the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open the RBA page myself, so it is worth checking against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are based on Byron Bay's own Numbeo figures. Accommodation also draws on comparison with Australian coastal resort towns such as Noosa and the Gold Coast, and with Sydney, where prices are similar or a little lower than Byron Bay's.
